content.short: Squirrel Wallet is a non-custodial mobile wallet with social-recovery guardians across 100+ chains.
content.description: Squirrel Wallet covers more than a hundred chains including Hyperliquid and Monad, and uses guardians for social recovery so losing a device does not mean losing the wallet. Recovery design is the part of self-custody that decides whether ordinary users can actually keep their own keys.
content.meta: Guardian-based recovery across 100+ chains, so a lost device is not a lost wallet.
